Premises: (1) the function is an effect-evidence gate for regression safety; (2) zero collected tests execute no assertions about the modified code; (3) `compute_sk()` treats numeric scores as weighted positive evidence and excludes only `None`; (4) therefore `1.0` here is semantically “maximal support”, not “unavailable”.
